fact: The Implementer supports feature, refactoring, bug-fix, perf-issue, hillclimb, experiment and experiment-fix playbooks.
Implementer dispatch selects a versioned playbook from the task type or the Taskbook Playbook field and loads its prompt for each Work State.
The plugin supplies the named-team implementer with bundled adaptations of PStack methods.
The repository catalogs adopted PStack and Matt Pocock methods in methods/pstack.json and methods/matt.json respectively.
